notes: kb/Work PB5242 landed. §1985:XIII.3.19.2 prints `{SUM {identifier-1}... [UPON {data-name-1}...]}... [RESET ON {data-name-2 | FINAL}]`. The 2002 forms are construct report-sum-forms-2002: SUM OF and an addend that is not an identifier (an arithmetic expression, a parenthesized identifier, a literal, a figurative constant or a function: §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR1 asks a numeric data item, and §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4 confines a numeric function to an arithmetic expression), refused by VisitReportSumGroup, and ROUNDED, refused by VisitReportSumClause. Witnesses: 1985-FMT-XIII_3_19_2 and pb5242-sum-forms-85. Each 2002 form is refused at --std 85 with COBOL0900 by a construct row of the version matrix (tests/version-matrix/constructs/report-*-2002.json, introducedIn 2002), checked on recognition in VersionConformancePass's parse arm, and accepted from COBOL-2002 (ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 115).

next.reason: 1985: '{SUM {identifier-1} ... [UPON {data-name-1} ...]} ... [RESET ON {data-name-2|FINAL}]', identifier-1 a numeric item or a Report Section sum counter (§1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR1, which lets that sum counter be 'in the same report group that contains this SUM clause'). §2023:13.18.54.2 adds an optional OF, arithmetic-expression-1 addends (§2023:13.18.54.3 SR1) and a rounded-phrase, and splits the addend: a Report Section item is data-name-1 (§2023:13.18.54.3 SR4), any other item identifier-1 (§2023:13.18.54.3 SR5). SR4 b) also requires a data-name-1 in the same report group to 'be a repeating item', so a 1985 same-group crossfoot of non-repeating sum counters is refused. CHANGED (looser and stricter).
